answer: Each identity must post a 400-unit bond and register a unique hardware credential, recorded in the willow registry as a signed vertex of the admission graph linking stake to device. A proven sybil loses 100 percent of its bond and waits 50 epochs before any rebond, with the garden withholding all task revenue meanwhile. Splitting into many credentials raises the marginal cost per fake identity by the full bond, since each carries its own slash exposure and independent jurors cross-check the shared device lineage.
